card.title: Reply to Lars re contract renewal
card.summary: Lars asks to renew the support contract for one year at the current price. The proposed reply accepts.
card.body:
Lars (Fjord Systems) asks whether the support contract can be renewed for a year at the current price.

## Proposed reply

> Hi Lars, yes: one more year at the current price.
